parameters.query:
SELECT m.id 
FROM public.mensagens m
JOIN public.lojas l ON l.id = m.loja_id
WHERE m.message_id = $1
  AND l.ativo = true
  AND (
    l.whatsapp_loja = $2
    OR l.config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'instanceName' = $3
    OR ($3 != '' AND ('loja-' || l.id::text) = $3)
  )
LIMIT 1;

SELECT id, nome, whatsapp_loja, config_json
FROM lojas
WHERE ativo = true
  AND (
    whatsapp_loja = $1
    OR config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'instanceName' = $2
    OR ($2 != '' AND ('loja-' || id::text) = $2)
  )
  AND $3::text != ''
  AND (
    $3::text = NULLIF($4::text, '')
    OR $3::text = NULLIF($5::text, '')
    OR $3::text = NULLIF(config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'apikey', '')
    OR $3::text = NULLIF(config_json->'evolutionapi'->>'token', '')
  )
ORDER BY id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.criativos (
    loja_id,
    ad_id,
    titulo,
    tema,
    canal,
    media_url,
    source_url,
    total_mensagens,
    primeira_mensagem_at,
    ultima_mensagem_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT 
    $1::int, 
    $2::text, 
    NULLIF($3::text, ''), 
    NULLIF($4::text, ''), 
    COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, ''), 'instagram'), 
    NULLIF($6::text, ''), 
    NULLIF($7::text, ''), 
    0, 
    COALESCE($8::timestamptz, NOW()), 
    COALESCE($8::timestamptz, NOW()), 
    NOW(), 
    NOW()
  WHERE $2::text != ''
  ON CONFLICT (loja_id, ad_id) DO UPDATE SET
    titulo = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.titulo, ''), criativos.titulo),
    tema = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.tema, ''), criativos.tema),
    canal = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.canal, ''), criativos.canal),
    media_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.media_url, ''), criativos.media_url),
    source_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.source_url, ''), criativos.source_url),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id as criativo_id FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::int as criativo_id
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO pessoas (
  loja_id,
  nome,
  whatsapp,
  origem,
  metadata_json,
  ultimo_criativo_id,
  total_mensagens,
  last_message_at,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), 'Contato ' || $3),
  $3,
  CASE WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN 'organico' ELSE $4 END,
  CASE WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE $5::jsonb END,
  CASE WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN NULL ELSE $6::int END,
  0,
  COALESCE($8::timestamptz, NOW()),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (loja_id, whatsapp) DO UPDATE
SET 
  nome = CASE 
    WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN pessoas.nome 
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.nome, ''), pessoas.nome)
  END,
  origem = CASE 
    WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN pessoas.origem 
    WHEN EXCLUDED.origem IN ('instagram_ads', 'facebook_ads', 'google_ads') THEN EXCLUDED.origem 
    ELSE pessoas.origem 
  END,
  metadata_json = CASE 
    WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN pessoas.metadata_json 
    WHEN EXCLUDED.metadata_json != '{}'::jsonb THEN EXCLUDED.metadata_json 
    ELSE pessoas.metadata_json 
  END,
  ultimo_criativo_id = CASE 
    WHEN $7::text = 'outbound' THEN pessoas.ultimo_criativo_id 
    ELSE COALESCE($6::int, pessoas.ultimo_criativo_id)
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, nome, whatsapp, origem, ultimo_criativo_id;

parameters.query:
WITH pending AS (
  SELECT id, timestamp_mensagem, criativo_id
  FROM public.mensagens
  WHERE loja_id = $1::int 
    AND pessoa_id = $2::bigint 
    AND direcao = 'inbound' 
    AND respondida_em IS NULL 
    AND $3::text = 'outbound'
    AND timestamp_mensagem <= COALESCE($5::timestamptz, NOW())
  ORDER BY timestamp_mensagem ASC 
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE($5::timestamptz, NOW()) - p.timestamp_mensagem))::integer) AS tempo_resposta_segundos,
  p.criativo_id
FROM pending p
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::int as tempo_resposta_segundos, NULL::int as criativo_id
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
WITH matched_outbound_for_late_inbound AS (
  SELECT m.message_id AS out_msg_id, m.timestamp_mensagem AS out_ts
  FROM public.mensagens m
  WHERE m.loja_id = $1::int
    AND m.pessoa_id = $2::bigint
    AND m.direcao = 'outbound'
    AND $4::text = 'inbound'
    AND m.timestamp_mensagem >= COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())
  ORDER BY m.timestamp_mensagem ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
pending_inbound_for_outbound AS (
  SELECT id, timestamp_mensagem, criativo_id
  FROM public.mensagens
  WHERE loja_id = $1::int
    AND pessoa_id = $2::bigint
    AND direcao = 'inbound'
    AND respondida_em IS NULL
    AND $4::text = 'outbound'
    AND timestamp_mensagem <= COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())
  ORDER BY timestamp_mensagem ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
ins_msg AS (
  INSERT INTO public.mensagens (
    loja_id,
    pessoa_id,
    message_id,
    direcao,
    tipo,
    conteudo,
    midia_url,
    status_entrega,
    is_ad,
    criativo_id,
    ctwa_clid,
    tempo_resposta_segundos,
    respondida_em,
    respondida_por_mensagem_id,
    metadata_json,
    timestamp_mensagem,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    $1::int,
    $2::bigint,
    $3::text,
    $4::text,
    $5::text,
    $6::text,
    $7::text,
    'received',
    CASE WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' THEN $8::boolean ELSE false END,
    CASE 
      WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' THEN $9::int 
      ELSE (SELECT criativo_id FROM pending_inbound_for_outbound)
    END,
    CASE WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' THEN NULLIF($10::text, '') ELSE NULL END,
    CASE 
      WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' 
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.mensagens prev_in
          WHERE prev_in.loja_id = $1::int
            AND prev_in.pessoa_id = $2::bigint
            AND prev_in.direcao = 'inbound'
            AND prev_in.respondida_por_mensagem_id = (SELECT out_msg_id FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound)
            AND prev_in.timestamp_mensagem < COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())
        )
      THEN GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT out_ts FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound) - COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())))::integer)
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    CASE 
      WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' THEN (SELECT out_ts FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound)
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    CASE 
      WHEN $4::text = 'inbound' THEN (SELECT out_msg_id FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound)
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    $11::jsonb,
    COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW()),
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (loja_id, message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, is_ad, criativo_id, tempo_resposta_segundos, timestamp_mensagem
),
clear_later_inbound_sla AS (
  UPDATE public.mensagens m
  SET tempo_resposta_segundos = NULL
  FROM matched_outbound_for_late_inbound mo
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
    AND (SELECT tempo_resposta_segundos FROM ins_msg) IS NOT NULL
    AND m.loja_id = $1::int
    AND m.pessoa_id = $2::bigint
    AND m.direcao = 'inbound'
    AND m.respondida_por_mensagem_id = mo.out_msg_id
    AND m.id != (SELECT id FROM ins_msg)
    AND m.tempo_resposta_segundos IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING m.id
),
sla_update AS (
  UPDATE public.mensagens m
  SET 
    respondida_em = COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW()),
    tempo_resposta_segundos = GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW()) - p.timestamp_mensagem))::integer),
    respondida_por_mensagem_id = $3::text
  FROM pending_inbound_for_outbound p
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
    AND m.id = p.id
  RETURNING m.id, m.tempo_resposta_segundos, m.criativo_id
),
close_burst AS (
  UPDATE public.mensagens m
  SET 
    respondida_em = COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW()),
    respondida_por_mensagem_id = $3::text
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pending_inbound_for_outbound)
    AND m.loja_id = $1::int
    AND m.pessoa_id = $2::bigint
    AND m.direcao = 'inbound'
    AND m.respondida_em IS NULL
    AND m.timestamp_mensagem <= COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())
    AND m.id != (SELECT id FROM pending_inbound_for_outbound)
  RETURNING m.id
),
upd_pessoa AS (
  UPDATE public.pessoas p
  SET 
    total_mensagens = p.total_mensagens + 1,
    last_message_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(p.last_message_at, COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())), COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())),
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
    AND p.id = $2::bigint
  RETURNING p.id
),
upd_criativo AS (
  UPDATE public.criativos c
  SET 
    total_mensagens = c.total_mensagens + 1,
    ultima_mensagem_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(c.ultima_mensagem_at, COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())), COALESCE($12::timestamptz, NOW())),
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
    AND $4::text = 'inbound'
    AND $9::int IS NOT NULL
    AND c.id = $9::int
  RETURNING c.id
),
ins_log AS (
  INSERT INTO public.webhook_evolution_logs (message_id, payload, created_at)
  SELECT $3::text, $13::jsonb, NOW()
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins_msg)
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 
  im.id,
  im.is_ad,
  im.criativo_id,
  COALESCE(im.tempo_resposta_segundos, (SELECT tempo_resposta_segundos FROM sla_update)) AS tempo_resposta_segundos
FROM ins_msg im
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::bigint AS id, false AS is_ad, NULL::int AS criativo_id, NULL::int AS tempo_resposta_segundos
LIMIT 1;
